Review n8n?

Reviewers largely see n8n as a powerful, flexible automation tool that shines once you get past the learning curve. Users repeatedly praise its visual workflow builder, strong API handling, self-hosting, privacy control, and ability to manage complex multi-step logic that feels limiting in Zapier or Make. Several say it is reliable and easier to read and debug than script-heavy setups. The main complaints are a steep setup and onboarding experience, gaps in some native integrations, and a few concerns around scaling, version control, and how open-source it feels.

results.title: n8n Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
The setup process alone took me several days. Not hours — days. For a solo operator or a small team without a dedicated technical resource, that upfront investment is a significant ask. It is part of why I think n8n is naturally better suited to slightly larger companies, where the setup burden can be shared and the price point makes more sense against the scale of what is being automated. [...] Being able to self-host means our data stays on our own infrastructure, which matters more than I expected once I sat down to actually think it through.

Open source, a genuine low-code platform, and enough depth in the node system to handle the odd multi-step process that off-the-shelf automation tools give up on.

#### What needs improvement

The setup took longer than expected. A calmer starting path for someone without a technical background would make the first week a lot less intimidating.

Prebuilt integrations could cover more ground out of the box. A few of our tools needed a workaround that a native connector would have avoided.

#### vs Alternatives [...] Data Sovereignty and Compliance (RGPD): As a French agency, data privacy is paramount. Self-hosting n8n is the only reliable way to guarantee 100% data sovereignty and RGPD compliance. We retain full control over the infrastructure, which is impossible with cloud-locked competitors.

Technical Depth and Customization: When projects move beyond simple trigger/action scenarios, n8n's ability to seamlessly integrate custom JavaScript, handle complex multi-step logic, and connect to proprietary APIs is unmatched. It's the only platform that offers the best of both the visual (No-Code) and the technical (DevOps/Code) worlds.
